schema: FEV publication-based coding v1.1 five-record deep audit

methodology.source_policy: primary publication/preprint plus linked code/data where available
important_limitations: Source-code checking was static: repository structure, documentation, tests, environments, releases, data and replay artifacts were reviewed where discoverable.
Assignments reflect publication-level evidence and may change with new versions or supplementary material.
V-levels are cumulative; qualifiers do not override missing lower requirements.
Clinical or diagnostic systems are not certified for clinical use by this coding.

records.title: Accelerating primer design for amplicon sequencing using large language model-powered agents
records.evaluated_use_case: Automated multiplex primer-panel design and experimental execution
records.coding_basis: Public repository contains multi-agent services, Docker/Compose setup, generated executable code, NCBI/primer/protocol integrations and logs; the paper reports multiple prospectively executed amplicon-sequencing applications with anomaly detection and corrective or human-escalation paths.

records.title: AgentGC: Evolutionary Learning-based Lossless Compression for Genomics Data with LLM-driven Multiple Agent
records.evaluated_use_case: Adaptive lossless genomic-data compression

validation.missing_lower_requirement: use-case replay is not established from the public anonymous artifact and paper-level material reviewed

records.coding_basis: Leader and Worker agents select and adapt compression strategies; nine datasets and 14 baselines are reported, but the accessible evidence did not establish a stable archival replay package with complete agent traces.

records.title: An agentic AI system for automated pharmacogenomic recommendation generation
records.evaluated_use_case: Evidence-grounded CPIC-style pharmacogenomic recommendation generation

validation.missing_lower_requirement: public use-case-specific code, prompts, dependencies and replay traces were not located

records.coding_basis: The modular pipeline retrieves full-text literature and FDA labels, extracts entities, aggregates evidence and generates phenotype-specific recommendations; extraction and expert-comparison results are reported, but no public source repository was found in the reviewed web material.

records.title: biomeStat: Using Agentic AI for Scalable Genomic Epidemiology Demonstrated Through End-to-End Analysis of 1,000 Asian Dengue Virus Genomes
records.evaluated_use_case: Autonomous dengue genomic epidemiology and structural analysis

validation.missing_lower_requirement: repository contains analysis scripts but not the full agent, environment lock, inputs and execution trace needed to replay the reported autonomous session

records.coding_basis: The paper reports sandboxed orchestration of IQ-TREE, TreeTime, BEAST2, HyPhy and PyMOL on 1,000 genomes; the linked repository has four analysis scripts and no release, so agent-layer replayability is not established.

records.title: BOLE: A Knowledge-Enhanced Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Genomic Breeding
records.evaluated_use_case: Autonomous genomic breeding workflows including GWAS and genomic selection
records.coding_basis: The public repository includes intent-parsing tests, workflow timing, error-handling conversations and a case-reproduction package with scripts and public GWAS data instructions; the paper describes artifact-level provenance and validated executable workflows. Deep audit confirmed that the public repository is a benchmark/reproduction package rather than the complete web-service source; V3 therefore applies to the released benchmarked workflows, not to independent reconstruction of the entire BOLE service.

records.title: CoNVict: An Agentic AI System for Copy Number Variation Prioritization in Rare Disease Diagnosis
records.evaluated_use_case: Phenotype-guided CNV prioritization for rare-disease diagnosis
records.coding_basis: Full PDF and official repository show a two-stage CNV-ranking pipeline using AnnotSV-enriched variants, phenotype/HPO context, CNVerdict triage and pairwise tournament ranking. The released benchmark includes 397 simulated diagnostic cases and plotting/reproduction assets. No runtime repair loop was demonstrated, so F5 is NR; tournament aggregation provides automated verification. Evaluation against comparator methods and difficult variant strata supports V3 [B,R,X].

records.title: CRISPR-GPT for agentic automation of gene-editing experiments
records.evaluated_use_case: CRISPR experiment planning, guide design and prospective knockout/activation studies

validation.missing_lower_requirement: the public repository is explicitly a limited lite/welcome implementation and withholds the complete code, data and prompts; V2 replayability is therefore not met

records.coding_basis: Full Nature paper reports planner, executor, user-proxy and tool providers across four editing modalities, with prospective Cas12a knockout and dCas9 activation experiments. The official repository contains only CRISPR-GPT-lite/welcome code, resources and logs and explicitly withholds the complete evaluated code, data and prompts for safety reasons. Thus prospective evaluation is retained as strongest evaluation and P qualifier, but cumulative Validation remains V1 because V2 replayability is unmet.

records.title: KBase Research Agent: Automated Multi-Agent Workflow Construction for Reproducible Genome Analysis
records.evaluated_use_case: Automated bacterial genome QC, assembly, taxonomy and annotation in KBase
records.coding_basis: Full PDF and mature official repository establish multi-agent planning, KBase KG/documentation grounding, application selection, parameterization, execution monitoring, validation and KBase Narrative persistence. Source includes package code, tests, notebooks, evaluation scripts, Poetry lockfile and Dockerfile. Planning/execution are evaluated against reference workflows and on 100 previously unanalyzed isolates, supporting V3 [B,R].

records.title: OncoCITE: Multimodal Multi-Agent Reconstruction of Clinical Oncology Knowledge Bases from Scientific Literature
records.evaluated_use_case: Source-grounded extraction and normalization of clinical genomic evidence from oncology papers
records.coding_basis: Full supplementary PDF and official LangGraph implementation expose Reader, Planner, Extractor, Critic and Normalizer stages, source-page quotes, confidence, critic-driven revision, SQLite checkpoints, state-history export, retries, tests and 11 bundled validation PDFs with curator ground truth. Three-way evaluation and discrepancy analysis support V3 [B,H,R].

records.title: Process-Supervised Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Reliable Clinical Reasoning
records.evaluated_use_case: ClinGen gene-disease validity curation with process-supervised multi-agent RL
records.coding_basis: Full PDF and official repository establish a hierarchical supervisor coordinating specialized evidence agents for ClinGen gene-disease validity curation, with structured SOP-aligned traces. Code includes core, evaluation, scripts, GRPO reward, SFT and training modules. Explicit outcome and process-fidelity comparisons and reward ablations support V3 [B,R]. The paper does not demonstrate a runtime deficiency-triggered repair loop, so F5 is NR.

records.title: An LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Debate System for Mendelian Diseases
records.evaluated_use_case: Mendelian disease gene prioritization through debate between data- and knowledge-driven agents
records.coding_basis: Full PDF and official repository establish DataAgent, KnowledgeAgent and DebateAgent stages integrating VCF/ANNOVAR-style data processing, HPO/knowledge resources and LLM debate. The repository includes prompts, shell orchestration, project configuration, Singularity-image instructions and an example VCF/HPO case. Evaluation on 1,185 samples across four datasets plus 72 difficult cases supports V3 [B,R,X]. No explicit deficiency-triggered repair or output sufficiency/escalation mechanism was demonstrated, so F5 and F6 are NR.

records.title: GeneAgent: self-verification language agent for gene-set analysis using domain databases
records.evaluated_use_case: Database-verified gene-set functional interpretation
records.coding_basis: Full Nature Methods paper and official repository show a cascade that generates gene-set interpretations, decomposes them into claims, queries curated biological databases through APIs, and revises unsupported process names and narratives. Released datasets, outputs, verification reports and evaluation notebook support replay; evaluation on 1,106 gene sets and seven expert-reviewed novel sets supports V3 [B,H,R].

records.title: GeneWhisperer: Enhancing manual genome annotation with large language models
records.evaluated_use_case: Human-in-the-loop manual gene functional annotation

validation.missing_lower_requirement: systematic task-appropriate scientific evaluation of the agent was not established

records.coding_basis: Full bioRxiv paper and final archived official repository establish a human-in-the-loop annotation assistant integrating literature/PDF retrieval, FAISS, PubMed, BLAST, ontology and knowledge-graph utilities. Source, environment files, examples, stored outputs and a final archived release support V2 replay. The paper is principally a hypothesis/prototype and case demonstration rather than a task-appropriate comparative agent evaluation, so cumulative Validation remains V2.

records.title: gffutilsAI: An AI-Agent for Interactive Genomic Feature Exploration in GFF files
records.evaluated_use_case: Natural-language exploration and export of GFF annotations
records.coding_basis: Full bioRxiv paper, supplementary/model transcripts and official installable repository establish natural-language selection of deterministic gffutils-backed coordinate, hierarchy, attribute, statistics and export tools. The package has pinned project metadata, uv.lock, notebooks and tagged releases, supporting V2 replay. The paper is a proof of concept without a task-appropriate benchmark or criterion-based evaluation; adaptive repair and sufficiency verification are not demonstrated.

records.title: A Versatile AI Agent for Rare Disease Diagnosis and Risk Gene Prioritization
records.evaluated_use_case: Multimodal rare-disease diagnosis and risk-gene prioritization
records.coding_basis: Full PDF and attributable repository establish a Biomni-derived multimodal agent with routing across phenotype, genetic and clinical-record workflows, knowledge grounding, risk-gene prioritization and confidence reporting. The repository exposes the derived agent modules, environment and tutorials but is a small five-commit project that depends heavily on Biomni and external data/services. Multiple diagnostic benchmarks, physician comparison and real-world record assistance support V3 [B,H,R,X], but this remains retrospective decision-support evaluation, not prospective clinical validation.

records.title: MRAgent: an LLM-based automated agent for causal knowledge discovery in disease via Mendelian randomization
records.evaluated_use_case: Automated literature-to-GWAS Mendelian-randomization analysis and reporting
records.coding_basis: The full peer-reviewed paper and official repository show literature scanning, exposure/outcome extraction, OpenGWAS selection, TwoSampleMR execution, sensitivity diagnostics and STROBE-MR reporting. The package, workflow demos, evaluation scripts, PyPI release and explicit automated/human evaluations support V3. Sensitivity analyses verify MR claims, but the reviewed workflow does not clearly show a failed result causing adaptive repair, so F5 is NR.

records.title: BioDiscoveryAgent: An AI Agent for Designing Genetic Perturbation Experiments
records.evaluated_use_case: Sequential design of genetic perturbation screens
records.coding_basis: The full revised paper and official repository show sequential perturbation selection using archived screen outcomes, literature and pathway/gene-search tools, code/data analysis and an AI critique tool. Released datasets/loaders, baselines, analysis code and run commands support replay. Six-dataset comparisons, non-essential-gene analysis, combination prediction and an unpublished held-out dataset support V3 [B,R,X]. Because rounds query archived outcomes, this is retrospective closed-loop simulation, not prospective P/C.

records.title: From Single to Multi-Agent Reasoning: Advancing GeneGPT for Genomics QA
records.evaluated_use_case: Multi-agent genomic question answering over NCBI/BLAST services

validation.missing_lower_requirement: the project page advertises code, but an attributable official repository and a stable use-case-specific replay package were not located; third-party AI-generated implementations were excluded

records.coding_basis: The full ECIR paper reports a manager coordinating specialist genomic QA agents and evaluates nine GeneTuring tasks against GeneGPT with accuracy and cost comparisons. The project page advertises code, but no attributable official repository or stable replay package was located in the reviewed web sources; an explicitly AI-generated third-party implementation was excluded. Therefore the strongest evaluation is V3-like retrospective benchmarking, but cumulative Validation remains V1 because V2 is unmet.

records.title: GeneGenie: enhancing biomedical question-answering with agentic graphs
records.evaluated_use_case: Tool-augmented biomedical QA with deterministic agent graph
records.coding_basis: The full peer-reviewed paper and official repository expose a deterministic five-node agent graph, RAG over GenCC/HGNC/UniProt, NCBI E-Utilities, local BLAST+, execution traces, checkpoint-resumable evaluation and report generation. The 1,600-question, 16-module GeneTuring study compares Direct and Graph modes across six models and uses exact and semantic judging, supporting V3 [B,R]. No deficiency-triggered workflow repair was demonstrated, so F5 is NR.

records.title: GenomeHarness: Harnessing Al Agents for Reliable Adaptation of Genome Language Models
records.evaluated_use_case: Agent-guided fine-tuning recipe search for genome language models
records.coding_basis: The full paper and official repository establish an agent-facing fine-tuning harness in which an AI agent proposes and repairs recipes, a protocol-constrained runtime executes trials and records state, and MCTS allocates search across lineages. Public code includes benchmark preparation, templates and the installable harness, although run outputs, checkpoints, local datasets, weights and ablation results are excluded. Three-seed frozen-recipe evaluation across 52 model-task settings, baselines and stability analyses support V3 [B,S,R].

records.title: GGBound: A Genome-Grounded Agent for Microbial Life-Boundary Prediction
records.evaluated_use_case: Genome-conditioned microbial life-boundary prediction

validation.missing_lower_requirement: official source code, trained weights, processed benchmark, prompts/trajectories and replay environment were not located

records.coding_basis: The full paper reports a genome-conditioned, tool-augmented agent combining LucaOne embeddings, similarity RAG and a genome-scale metabolic-model perturbation tool, trained by alignment, agentic SFT and GRPO. Evaluation uses 1,525 strains and 6,448 instances with large-model baselines and component/reward ablations. No official implementation, weights, processed benchmark or replay environment was located, so cumulative Validation remains V1 despite V3-strength B/S/R evaluation.

records.title: RareCollab: an LLM-powered framework for multimodal reasoning in Mendelian disease diagnosis
records.evaluated_use_case: Multimodal Mendelian diagnosis using DNA, RNA, phenotype and curated evidence

validation.missing_lower_requirement: the two-commit package exposes core modules but not the three-cohort patient data, complete model/configuration assets, or an end-to-end evaluation/reproduction pipeline sufficient to establish V3 cumulatively

records.coding_basis: The full paper reports integration of more than 100 signals across DNA, RNA, phenotype, curated variant knowledge and in-silico predictions, evaluated on 890 patients from three cohorts including 119 paired DNA/RNA UDN cases. The official two-commit package exposes specialist modules and the Diagnostic Engine, but lacks the controlled cohort data and complete evaluation pipeline. This supports V2 replay of the software architecture but not cumulative V3 for the reported cohort study.

records.title: Beyond GeneGPT: A Multi-Agent Architecture with Open-Source LLMs for Enhanced Genomic Question Answering
records.evaluated_use_case: Open-source multi-agent genomic QA
records.coding_basis: The full SIGIR-AP paper and official repository document a GeneGPT pilot reproduction and a LangGraph/LangChain multi-agent system with Router, Search, BLAST, EUtils, Evaluator and Generator roles. GeneTuring and GeneHop comparisons, failure analysis and latency measurements show performance on 11 of 12 tasks and 40-50% latency reduction. Public implementation, datasets and evaluation scripts support V3 [B,R].

records.title: BioRAGent: natural language biomedical querying with retrieval-augmented multiagent systems
records.evaluated_use_case: Natural-language biomedical database querying and multi-hop QA
records.coding_basis: The peer-reviewed full text and official repository establish Guide, Retriever and Reviewer agents, biomedical resource files, orchestration, Docker setup, evaluation datasets, agreement analysis and ablation code. The paper evaluates 11 single-hop and three multi-hop tasks against state-of-the-art models and includes user assessment and agent ablations. Reviewer-based answer validation and refinement support F5/F6 and V3 [B,H,R].

records.title: Nano Bio-Agents (NBA): Small Language Model Agents for Genomics
records.evaluated_use_case: Small-model genomics QA with task decomposition and NCBI/AlphaGenome tools
records.coding_basis: The full paper and official repository establish task decomposition, programmatic NCBI/AlphaGenome tool use, output parsing, API caching, monitoring and benchmark evaluation. Public package code, tests, examples, GeneTuring data/results and comparison scripts support replay. Comparisons across agent, GeneGPT, direct-LLM and function-call modes and many model backbones support V3 [B,R]. Monitoring errors alone does not prove deficiency-triggered repair, so F5 is NR.

records.title: TusoAI: Agentic Optimization for Scientific Methods
records.evaluated_use_case: Autonomous development and optimization of scientific computational methods
records.coding_basis: The full paper and official repository establish coordinated literature mining, knowledge-tree construction, code editing, execution, diagnosis, scoring, memory and iterative repair over candidate methods. Tests, examples, notebooks and evaluation assets support replay. Comparative evaluations across diverse tasks, genetics applications, expert methods and other agents, with statistical and external analyses, support V3 [B,S,R,X].

records.title: Qimai: a multi-agent framework for zero-shot DNA-protein interaction prediction
records.evaluated_use_case: Zero-shot DNA-protein interaction prediction from motif, PPI and neural evidence
records.coding_basis: The full paper and official repository show a LangGraph framework integrating direct CisBP/FIMO motif evidence, indirect STRING cofactor evidence and transformer prediction, with LLM synthesis and rule-based confidence. Data/model directories, requirements, evaluation scripts and JSON outputs support replay. Evaluation on 78 unseen proteins, baselines, cross-validation and evidence ablations supports V3 [B,S,R,X]. Dynamic evidence weighting is not deficiency-triggered repair, so F5 is NR.

records.title: GPAS: an online AI system for rapid and accurate pathogen identification and LLM-based interpretation
records.system_name: Global Pathogen Analysis System (2026 AI system)
records.evaluated_use_case: Metagenomic pathogen identification and LLM-based evidence interpretation

validation.missing_lower_requirement: the complete evaluated GPAS identification pipeline, GenoDB/GenoKG snapshots, trained pathogen-agent checkpoint, exact production environment, prompts and end-to-end replay scripts were not located in a paper-attributable public repository; the GPAS-Team/DeepMicroPath repository appears related to the LLM training component but does not establish replay of the full evaluated system

records.coding_basis: The full medRxiv paper and extended-data PDF report an integrated pipeline with GenoDB dynamic-library alignment, an inter-species misclassification prior, elastic-neural-network/Bayesian identification, a microbial knowledge graph, and a reinforcement-learned pathogen-specialized LLM agent. The system is evaluated on simulated, public and throat-swab datasets against pathogen-identification comparators, with statistical and robustness analyses. A GPAS-Team repository exposes DeepMicroPath training/inference/evaluation code, tests, requirements, logs and a large microbiology QA dataset, but it does not release the complete GPAS identification pipeline, database snapshots, trained checkpoint or exact end-to-end reproduction package. Therefore cumulative Validation remains V1 despite V3-strength retrospective evaluation.

audit_summary.finding: All five records were rechecked against full text or PDF and source artifacts where available. PrimeGen and BOLE have comparatively strong public artifacts; AgentGC relies on an anonymous review mirror; biomeStat releases study scripts but not the complete agent; the pharmacogenomics system has no official public repository located.
audit_summary.source_scope: Article/full PDF, supplementary material when available, and static review of attributable repositories or review artifacts through 2026-09-11. No independent execution.
correction_policy: N was changed to NR where absence was not explicitly assessed and failed.
F5 requires detected insufficiency followed by an actual workflow or output change.
V2 requires use-case-specific replay assets, not code availability alone.
Prospective testing yields V4 only after cumulative V1-V3 requirements.
